hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Traverse each floor destination in the given service request order.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Add absolute distance between consecutive floors to the total travel distance.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Update the elevator position after serving each floor request.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def elevatorTotalTravel(requests: list[int], start_floor: int) -> int:
    cur = start_floor
    total = 0
    for req in requests:
        total += abs(req - cur)
        cur = req
    return total
```

solutions.code:
def elevatorTotalTravel(requests: list[int], start_floor: int) -> int:
    cur = start_floor
    total = 0
    for req in requests:
        total += abs(req - cur)
        cur = req
    return total
